decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The works to which this consent relates, must be begun not later than the expiration of five years beginning with the date of this consent.

Condition : 2 - Lower Ground Floor - cellar. Notwithstanding the plan layout shown on drawing 25.6, the change creating a new door opening and closing the existing access shall be carried out only if it appears structurally necessary to assist with existing load paths. In this event a scheme showing the changes shall be submitted to the Local Planning Authority following the structural survey and prior to the commencement of the works. The works shall be completed in accordance with the submitted details. If this work is to be carried out, structural heads/lintols shall be expressed.

Condition : 3 - Lower Ground Floor Cellar. The rear utility room is to have a new opening made in the rear wall to give access to the new extended basement. The head of the opening is to be visible and take the form of a segmental arch. Waterproofing/tanking measures shall be carried out only to the new basement unless prior approval has been agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 4 - A scheme showing the area of the basement floor to be lowered shall be submitted to the Local Planning Authority before the relevant part of the works are commenced. The scheme shall be located so as not to affect the stud partition, which is to be retained along with skirting plinths and wall mouldings generally in the basement. The scheme shall be completed in accordance with the approved details.

Condition : 5 - Ground Floor. Blocking in the corridor access and removing the corridor wall is approved subject to the retention of features indicating the cellular former layout. Notwithstanding the  plan layout shown on drawing 25.6 the infill shall be by way of a timber panel in the location of the former door. Removal of the remaining length of wall shall commemnce from the door position, leaving a return nib.

Condition : 6 - Ground Floor. Removal of the lean-to utility outbuilding: although not original, this would have been an early extension and as such English Heritage advice is to retain adaptations and accretions where these demonstrate bringing sanitary facilities etc. to original shells. Notwithstanding the plan layout shown on drawing 25.6 the length of external rear wall between the existing access opening and the existing kitchen-sink window, located at the junction of the corrodor wall, shall be retained as a pier. Removal of the outbuilding wall shall commence the other side of the pier. The short length of wall forming a pier  against the party wall shall be retained (or may be extended as indicated on the drawing). A similar short pier shall be retained at the junction of the w.c. wall with the brick garden wall.
Condition : 7 - The kitchen walls are to be reinstated in the original location. The head of the opening shall also be expressed.

Condition : 8 - Befrore the works hereby approved are commenced, details of the materials to be used on the flat roof, flashings, making good works to previous unexposed brickwork, rainwater goods, foul drainage pipes,alterations to the garden wall and copings adjacent to the boundary, external finishes, shall be illustrated or where appropriate samples shall be submitted, in accordance with a scheme to be submitted to the Local Planning Authority before the relevant part of the works is commenced. The scheme shall be completed in accordance with the approved details.

Condition : 9 - INFORMATIVES:

          (1) Lower ground floor: cellar. The exit position for S.V.P. drainage shall be further investigated. This shall be surveyed and recorded, and the scheme amended in accordance with details to be submitted.

          (2) Lower ground floor-cellar. An existing recess adjacent is to be enclosed with doors. This must be well ventillated to resist humid conditions becoming detrimental to the structure.

          (3) Any findings which suggest alterations to the design which affect the fabric of the building shall be notified and approved in advance. All investigations shall be recorded in detail to retain the information found. It is strongly recommended that a log-book be commenced recording the survey drawings and further information, plus the intentions and as-built works.
description: Extension of lower ground (cellar) to create playroom, erection of rear conservatory incorporating rear steps to access lower ground.
